device_menu.title: Add zones
device_menu.description: Configured zones: {zone_count}. Each zone creates a stateless trigger button and, when feedback fields are filled in, a separate status entity.

add_device.title: Add zone
add_device.description: Create one BeWave zone. The trigger command becomes a button entity. The feedback messages create a separate read-only status entity.

tcp.title: Connect BeWave hub
tcp.description: Configure the IP address or hostname of the BeWave hub.

mqtt.title: BE WAVE via MQTT
mqtt.description: Use the same MQTT broker as BE WAVE. Status base topic matches Publish topic in BE WAVE. Command base topic matches Subscribe topic in BE WAVE. Example: status bewave and command bewave/command. Devices appear when telemetry arrives.

edit_device.title: Edit zone

mqtt.description: Change the name, command base topic and expiry. Command base topic must match Subscribe topic in BE WAVE. To change broker IP, open [the MQTT integration](/config/integrations/integration/mqtt) and select Reconfigure.
